meta.note: Edited here, in Claude Design. The repository carloslucero-map/slides-skills copies this system one way into its wpp-es-html-deck skill (authoring/refresh_design_system.py) and never writes back: never re-sync this system from the repository.

tokens.name: wpp-navy
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Body text, logo, dots, chart ink and the dark-moment background. Pantone 2758 C. Navy carries the brand, but Cream and White must always be used in excess of it across a deck.

tokens.name: wpp-cream
tokens.usage: The single default slide background, on every content slide. Pantone 9064 C. Never alternate it with pure White across a deck: side by side Cream reads warm and White reads cold.

tokens.name: wpp-white
tokens.usage: Text on Navy and Orange 900. As a background it is a rare deliberate device only (a full-bleed halftone field, a single gallery moment), never a casual alternate to Cream.

tokens.name: orange-900
tokens.usage: Darkest step of the accent ramp. Pantone 175 C. Chart fills and accents; always takes White text.

tokens.name: orange-800
tokens.usage: Pantone 7598 C. The eyebrow subtitle and the divider sub-label. May carry short, large Navy text such as labels inside chart circles; never body copy.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: The default dot colour and the primary accent. Pantone 158 C. The cover month line, agenda numerals and the favourable-stat highlight. Never headlines, bullets or body copy.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Pantone 135 C. Dots, chart fills and the divider sub-label on a navy-full colourway. Never a text-bearing background: the playbook forbids it outright.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Pantone 9140. The one sanctioned tint background, for occasional accent moments and panel fills. Navy text on it reaches AAA.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The slide ground. Cream on every content slide; Navy on the .slide--navy dark moments (dividers, outros, statement slides) that punctuate the deck.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: The rare White ground: .slide--white, and the lower band of a .slide--ground partial-height ground change (default split y = 580px).

tokens.name: bg-tint
tokens.usage: The .slide--tint accent ground and tint panel fills. Use sparingly: one tint moment reads as deliberate, several read as a second default.

tokens.name: bg-dark
tokens.usage: The dark-moment ground behind .slide--navy. A punctuation background, never the deck's base.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All running text. Only Navy and White ever set type; the sanctioned orange text moments are listed individually in the brand book.

tokens.name: text-inv
tokens.usage: Type knocked out of a dark ground — the .slide--navy colour, divider titles knocked out of a large navy dot, and labels inside Navy or Orange 900 chart circles.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The default accent and the default dot colour, Orange 700. Accents in general may be Navy or any step of the orange ramp, as the Colour guideline's role mapping says.

tokens.name: data-pos
tokens.usage: The .stat--pos highlight: a number whose direction is meaningful and favourable. Favourable follows meaning, not arithmetic sign — −41% cycle time glows, +8% churn does not. One per slide, maximum, and at weight 300 or heavier below 90px.

tokens.name: data-neg
tokens.usage: The .stat--neg declaration: an unfavourable number, semantically marked but visually identical to default ink. Note it is not re-declared for the Navy ground, so a .stat--neg stat on a navy slide resolves to Navy on Navy — set those stats in text-inv by hand.

tokens.name: tert-pink
tokens.usage: Tertiary palette, information graphics only. Large text only — never body text, never a background, never decoration.

tokens.name: tert-red
tokens.usage: Tertiary palette, information graphics only. Large text only. Carries no good/bad meaning: direction is carried by the sign and by data-pos.

tokens.name: tert-purple
tokens.usage: Tertiary palette, information graphics only. Large text only.

tokens.name: tert-blue
tokens.usage: Tertiary palette, information graphics only. Large text only.

tokens.name: tert-turquoise
tokens.usage: Tertiary palette, information graphics only. Large text only.

tokens.name: tert-green
tokens.usage: Tertiary palette, information graphics only. Large text only — and never as a success cue: the palette has no green/red semantics.

tokens.name: tert-yellow
tokens.usage: Tertiary palette, information graphics only. Large text only.

tokens.name: tert-magenta
tokens.usage: Tertiary dark set, information graphics only. Accessible for large and body text with White type.

tokens.name: tert-maroon
tokens.usage: Tertiary dark set, information graphics only. White type.

tokens.name: tert-plum
tokens.usage: Tertiary dark set, information graphics only. White type.

tokens.name: tert-navy
tokens.usage: Tertiary dark set, information graphics only. The same ink as wpp-navy, listed in the template's tertiary set for completeness. White type.

tokens.name: tert-teal-deep
tokens.usage: Tertiary dark set, information graphics only. White type.

tokens.name: tert-green-deep
tokens.usage: Tertiary dark set, information graphics only. White type.

tokens.name: tert-olive
tokens.usage: Tertiary dark set, information graphics only. White type.

tokens.name: tert-indigo
tokens.usage: Tertiary dark set, information graphics only. White type. Head of the wider WPP indigo-violet pillar ramp, which is reference only — the ES pillar ramp is the Orange one.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Big Statement slides. Thin is for large-format display copy only; the shipped range is 81–220px, 220 on the poster statement. ALL CAPS or sentence case.

styles.name: big-quote
styles.usage: The Big Quote slide. Sentence case with curly quotes.

styles.name: divider-title
styles.usage: Divider number and title, ALL CAPS. Shares its size with the divider numeral.

styles.name: hero-num
styles.usage: The single dominant numeral on a hero-stat slide (.hero-num; --s 144px, --l 280px). One per slide.

styles.name: kpi-num
styles.usage: Numerals in the .kpi dashboard row, above a short description. Tabular lining numerals.

styles.name: agenda-num
styles.usage: Agenda numerals in Orange 700, set as “1.”. Drops to 72px in the 6-chapter dense mode.

styles.name: stat-circle-num
styles.usage: The numeral inside a stat circle. Below 90px a favourable orange stat must step up to weight 300 — Thin orange on Cream measures only about 2.5:1.

styles.name: outro-title
styles.usage: The outro “Thank you”. Sentence case.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: The locked cover title, ALL CAPS, max-width 1040px.

styles.name: headline-lg
styles.usage: The measured bank headline size (32pt × 2). Canon templates use this; the 54px default is inherited from the retired ×1.5 conversion factor.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The default slide headline. Sentence case, max two lines, sitting at y = 73px. May carry exactly one Medium-weight .hl token.

styles.name: agenda-chapter
styles.usage: Agenda chapter titles, sentence case. Drops to 42px in dense mode.

styles.name: headline-caps
styles.usage: The ALL-CAPS “strong emphasis” headline variant. Use on no more than one content slide in four.

styles.name: cover-subheader
styles.usage: The cover subheader, sentence case, max-width 900px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy in the content band, max-width 1200px. Regular since v4 — the weight step below the Light headline is what creates the hierarchy, not size alone.

styles.name: body-column
styles.usage: Body copy inside a column layout.

styles.name: body-compact
styles.usage: Body copy in four-column and box layouts, and .datatable cells. The floor for body copy is 20px.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: The Regular ALL-CAPS sub-headline at the top of the content band. Supports the headline or leads the body copy; this tier, not bold, is how you emphasise inside running text.

styles.name: cover-meta
styles.usage: The cover month and presenter lines. The month is ALL CAPS in Orange 700 at −0.01em.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The optional ALL-CAPS eyebrow subtitle under the headline, in Orange 800, at y = 177px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: ALL-CAPS labels: stat-circle labels, table headers, column headers.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: The pill chip label, ALL CAPS, on a 999px Navy fill with 10×26px padding. Moved from 15px to 16px so it clears the informational-text floor.

styles.name: title-highlight
styles.usage: The .hl span inside a title: the one key token set Medium at the same size and colour. Weight only — never orange, never underlined, never a size bump, and never inside body copy.

styles.name: footer-brand
styles.usage: The standing footer lockup “WPP Enterprise Solutions | MAP”, bottom-right. The only place the shipped Bold weight is used — never for body emphasis. In Claude Design Slides, set it in WPP Medium: Bold would be a fifth face, and a deck loads four.

styles.name: source
styles.usage: The source or citation line, bottom-left at 75% opacity. Frozen furniture size.

styles.name: pageno
styles.usage: Page number and the PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL line, ALL CAPS at 70% opacity. Frozen at 11px — never add new text at this size.

spacing.note: The canvas is 1920×1080 at 16:9. PowerPoint equivalent is 960×540pt, so pt × 2 = px.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The base square module. Everything snaps to it: 40px grid, 40px margins, 40px column space.

tokens.name: m-edge
tokens.usage: The left/right content edge used by the headline, eyebrow, content band and footer furniture. One grid module.

tokens.name: m-text
tokens.usage: The deeper text edge for a column of running copy, matching the measured mode of real body copy in the source deck.

tokens.name: band-top
tokens.usage: Top of the content band, below the headline and eyebrow.

tokens.name: band-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom inset of the content band, clearing the source line and footer furniture.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Column gutter in the 2- and 3-column grids. Columns measure 860px at 2-up and about 547px at 3-up on the 1800px column grid.

tokens.name: gutter-tight
tokens.usage: Column gutter in the 4-column grid, where columns measure 408px.

tokens.name: headline-y
tokens.usage: Top of the headline block, from the top of the canvas.

tokens.name: eyebrow-y
tokens.usage: Top offset of the optional eyebrow subtitle.

tokens.name: ground-y
tokens.usage: Default split for the .slide--ground partial-height ground change — the value measured off the source deck, not a chosen round number.

tokens.name: canvas-w
tokens.usage: Design canvas width.

tokens.name: canvas-h
tokens.usage: Design canvas height.

radius.note: The system is flat and geometric: circles and pills carry the brand, everything else is square. No shadows exist anywhere in the shipped stylesheet.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, boxes, panels and tiles. Square corners, flat fill, no border and no shadow — rounding is reserved for pills.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and chips only: column headers, tags, category labels.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Dots, stat circles, orbit nodes and every chart mark. The dot is the system's primary device — when in doubt, express it as a circle.

tokens.name: opacity-source
tokens.usage: The source/citation line.

tokens.name: opacity-furniture
tokens.usage: Page number and the confidential line.
